note: The AEE dynamic variation families. A family declares named options and one resolver that maps a selected value combination to a concrete artifact. The option values are NOT hand-listed: tools/gen_variation_families.py derives each option's value list from the table named in its source field, so a new symbol in the shipped tables becomes a new option value with no edit here. This file is the single declaration; the generator emits addons/symbology/config_variations.hpp (the CfgMarkers family entry and the CfgMarkerClasses group) and addons/symbology/data/variation_families.sqf (the runtime model). The mechanism is AEE's own; the idea of one option-driven entry is taken from AceArsenalExtended and reimplemented, with no code, config or art copied.
